# Ezekiel 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, what you-find, eat; eat this scroll, and-go, speak to the-house-of Israel."

**2** And-I-opened my-mouth, and-He-fed-me this scroll.

**3** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, your-belly you-shall-fill and-your-inward-parts you-shall-fill with-this scroll which I [am]-giving to-you." And-I-ate, and-it-was in-my-mouth like-honey for-sweetness.

**4** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, go — come to the-house-of Israel, and-speak with-My-words to-them.

**5** For not to a-people deep-of lip and-heavy-of tongue you [are]-sent — [but] to the-house-of Israel.

**6** Not to peoples many, deep-of lip and-heavy-of tongue, whose words you-cannot understand. If to-them I-sent-you — they would-listen to-you!

**7** But the-house-of Israel will-not be-willing to-listen to-you, for they-are-not willing to-listen to-Me; for all the-house-of Israel [are] strong-of forehead and-hard-of heart.

**8** Behold, I-have-made your-face strong against their-faces, and-your-forehead strong against their-foreheads.

**9** Like-diamond, harder than-flint, I-have-made your-forehead. Do-not-fear-them and-do-not-be-dismayed before-them, for a-house-of rebellion they [are]."

**10** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, all My-words which I-speak to-you, receive in-your-heart and-with-your-ears hear.

**11** And-go — come to the-exiles, to the-sons-of your-people, and-speak to-them, and-say to-them, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH,' whether they-hear or-whether they-refuse."

**12** And-the-spirit lifted-me, and-I-heard behind-me [the]-sound-of a-great rushing: "Blessed [be the]-glory-of YHWH from-His-place!"

**13** And-[the]-sound-of [the]-wings-of the-living-creatures touching each-one her-sister, and-[the]-sound-of the-wheels beside-them, and-[the]-sound-of a-great rushing.

**14** And-the-spirit lifted-me and-took-me, and-I-went bitter in-the-heat-of my-spirit, and-the-hand-of YHWH upon-me [was] strong.

**15** And-I-came to the-exiles at-Tel-Abib, the-ones-dwelling by the-river Chebar, and-I-sat where they [were] sitting, and-I-remained-there seven days — desolate in-their-midst.

**16** And-it-was at-the-end-of seven days, and-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**17** "Son-of man, a-watchman I-have-made-you for-the-house-of Israel; and-you-shall-hear [the]-word from-My-mouth, and-you-shall-warn-them from-Me.

**18** In-My-saying to-the-wicked, 'Dying you-shall-die,' and-you-do-not-warn-him and-you-do-not-speak to-warn the-wicked from-his-way, the-wicked-one — he in-his-iniquity will-die, but-his-blood from-your-hand I-will-require.

**19** And-you — if you-warn the-wicked and-he-does-not-turn from-his-wickedness and-from-his-way the-wicked, he in-his-iniquity will-die, and-you — your-soul you-have-delivered.

**20** And-in-the-turning-of [the]-righteous from-his-righteousness, and-he-does injustice, and-I-put a-stumbling-block before-him — he will-die; because you-did-not-warn-him, in-his-sin he-will-die, and-his-righteous-deeds which he-did will-not-be-remembered, but-his-blood from-your-hand I-will-require.

**21** And-you — if you-warn the-righteous not to-sin, [the]-righteous-one, and-he does-not-sin — living he-shall-live because he-was-warned, and-you — your-soul you-have-delivered."

**22** And-the-hand-of YHWH was upon-me there, and-He-said to-me, "Arise, go-out to the-valley, and-there I-will-speak with-you."

**23** And-I-arose and-went-out to the-valley, and-behold, there the-glory-of YHWH [was] standing, like-the-glory which I-saw by the-river Chebar, and-I-fell upon my-face.

**24** And-the-spirit entered into-me and-stood-me upon my-feet, and-He-spoke with-me and-said to-me, "Go, shut-yourself inside your-house.

**25** And-you, son-of man — behold, they-will-put upon-you ropes, and-they-will-bind-you with-them, and-you-will-not-go-out in-their-midst.

**26** And-your-tongue I-will-make-cling to-your-palate, and-you-will-be-mute, and-you-will-not-be to-them a-man [who]-reproves, for a-house-of rebellion they [are].

**27** And-in-My-speaking with-you, I-will-open your-mouth, and-you-shall-say to-them, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH.' The-one-who-hears, let-him-hear, and-the-one-who-refuses, let-him-refuse — for a-house-of rebellion they [are].

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **3:3**: Va-tokh be-fi ki-devash le-metoq — 'and it was in my mouth like honey for sweetness.' Cf. Ps 19:10, 119:103. God's word is sweet even when its content is bitter — the paradox of prophetic calling.

- **3:12**: Barukh kevod-YHWH mi-meqomo — 'Blessed be the glory of YHWH from His place.' A doxology heard during the spirit-transport. This phrase enters the Kedushah liturgy of later Judaism.

- **3:17**: Tsofeh — 'watchman.' The metaphor defines Ezekiel's role: not originator of the message but sentinel who relays divine warning. Blood-guilt transfers to the silent watchman (cf. 33:1-9).

— EMET
